business_problem: In an era dominated by digital content, India's ABP Network stands out for strategically employing generative artificial intelligence (AI) on Amazon Web Services (AWS) to revolutionize media content creation and procurement. This innovative approach significantly reduced costs and time, enhancing the media conglomerate's competitiveness in the dynamic media landscape.
solution_summary: In an era dominated by digital content, India's ABP Network stands out for strategically employing generative artificial intelligence (AI) on Amazon Web Services (AWS) to revolutionize media content creation and procurement. This innovative approach significantly reduced costs and time, enhancing the media conglomerate's competitiveness in the dynamic media landscape. ABP Network's journey in 2023 to deploy Amazon Bedrock marked a transformative step. This service simplifies the development and scaling of generative AI applications using foundation models, streamlining media production workflows for the company and significantly reducing costs. One notable advancement is an image-generating application, seamlessly integrated with the Content Management System. This application empowers the editorial team to generate upwards of 170 variations of the same image in under 10 seconds, using just simple text prompts.

solution_components.name: Amazon Bedrock
solution_components.role: Hosts the foundation models and generative AI application logic.

solution_components.name: Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud
solution_components.role: Provides scalable compute capacity for application services or AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Amazon RDS for MySQL
solution_components.role: Stores relational application data for production services.

data_flow: Data is stored in Amazon RDS for MySQL and processed by Amazon Bedrock.
business_outcome: With the AWS services being fully managed and highly scalable, the media company successfully implemented its AI-based solutions within seven days with a four-member team. AWS also worked closely with ABP Network’s editorial team to upskill their AI capabilities. They are now adept at creating more effective text prompts, elevating the quality of the images produced.
metrics: 50% cost savings on image acquisition and production

evidence_quotes: ABP Network publishes millions of stories, videos, social media posts and multimedia content across eight languages annually on ABP LIVE, leveraging high-quality images to boost engagement and click-through rates.
